About the role
We are hiring a Graduate Data Analyst to turn operational data into clear reporting for business stakeholders.

What you will do
- Write SQL against warehouse tables and validate data quality
- Build and maintain Power BI and Tableau dashboards
- Clean and wrangle datasets in Python (Pandas)
- Document reporting logic, data lineage, and business rules
- Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements and present findings

What we look for
- SQL and Python for analysis
- Dashboarding in Power BI or Tableau
- Strong communication with technical and non-technical audiences
- Full Australian work rights

About the role
Business Analyst supporting process documentation, requirements gathering, and reporting for a transformation program.

What you will do
- Engage stakeholders and document current-state processes and business rules
- Translate requirements into reporting and system designs
- Work in Jira and Confluence
- Use SQL and Excel to analyse operational data

What we look for
- Requirements gathering and stakeholder communication
- SQL, Excel, and structured documentation
- Hybrid Melbourne
